description: This file implements an approval system for managing direct messages, channel mentions, and group invites within a bot framework. It includes functions for creating, formatting, parsing, and managing approval requests and responses, as well as admin commands for blocking/unblocking ships and listing pending requests.

methods.name: generateApprovalId
methods.description: Generate a unique approval ID in the format: {type}-{timestamp}-{shortHash}

methods.name: createPendingApproval
methods.description: Create a pending approval object with provided parameters

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncate text to a maximum length with ellipsis

methods.name: formatApprovalRequest
methods.description: Format a notification message for the owner about a pending approval

methods.name: parseApprovalResponse
methods.description: Parse an owner's response to an approval request, supporting various formats

methods.name: isApprovalResponse
methods.description: Check if a message text looks like an approval response

methods.name: findPendingApproval
methods.description: Find a pending approval by ID or return the most recent

methods.name: hasDuplicatePending
methods.description: Check if there's already a pending approval for the same ship/channel/group

methods.name: removePendingApproval
methods.description: Remove a pending approval from the list by ID

methods.name: formatApprovalConfirmation
methods.description: Format a confirmation message after an approval action

methods.name: parseAdminCommand
methods.description: Parse an admin command from owner message

methods.name: isAdminCommand
methods.description: Check if a message text looks like an admin command

methods.name: formatBlockedList
methods.description: Format the list of blocked ships for display

methods.name: formatPendingList
methods.description: Format the list of pending approvals for display
